propositions: Close must run plan-review signature and validity checks before completion verification when require_plan_review_for_close is enabled, failing with exact verdict and separate review-plan remediation
CLOSE profile disables code freshness validation but enforces signature, reopen, registry, material, phase compatibility, and optional pin health checks as independent validity conditions

pre_status_check callback executes inside the existing transaction lock after structural checks and fresh state read but before STATUS append, catching plan/signature/material/phase/pin changes between precheck and lock
Unsigned, reopened, stale-registry, own-material drift, malformed metadata, and phase incompatibility always block close regardless of pin enforcement setting
Pin drift/missing/malformed blocks close only when verify.enforce_plan_material_pins is true; disabled enforcement keeps pins advisory
Bugs, session logs, code reviews, identities, and idea→closed retain existing exemptions; non-empty force-close bypasses both gates but never structural child closure
